short_description: In-between fat cell: sits in white fat depots but can be switched to a heat-producing state ('browning') by cold or exercise. Responds to irisin (from muscle) and noradrenaline. A therapeutic target against obesity.
do_not_draw: No single giant unilocular lipid droplet filling the whole cell with the nucleus squashed flat at the rim - that is a resting WHITE adipocyte, not the activated beige state we are illustrating

No wall-to-wall dense packing of huge mitochondria dominating the whole cytoplasm like a classic brown adipocyte - beige mitochondria are numerous and inducible but the droplets stay larger/fewer than brown fat's tiny multilocular droplets; keep it visibly INTERMEDIATE
No cell wall, nucleoid, plasmids or bacterial flagella - this is a human animal cell
No chloroplasts or large central plant-style vacuole
Capillaries and nerve fibres stay outside the cell body, touching but not penetrating the cytoplasm
Single specimen or a small readable cluster, not a dense unreadable sheet
